title: Quant Developer
summary: Quant developers build the software that trading firms use to read market data, run trading strategies and send orders, where every microsecond counts. They sit with quant researchers and traders, writing fast C++ for live systems and Python for research tools.
dailyDuties: Write and review C++ for trading and market data systems
Profile and cut latency on the order path
Build exchange gateways and order book handlers
Turn researcher strategy ideas into production code
Write Python tools for backtests and data checks
Monitor live trading systems and fix issues during market hours

skills.expectation: Write production C++ for trading and market data systems
Use C++17 or later, templates and the STL with care for performance
Measure and cut latency: cache-aware code, memory layout, kernel bypass networking
Write lock-free and multithreaded code that is correct under load
Build order books, exchange gateways and strategy plumbing on market data feeds
Choose data structures and algorithms for tight time budgets
Work on Linux and tune servers, processes and the network stack
Understand TCP/IP and UDP multicast used by exchange feeds
Write Python for research tools, backtests and data checks
Read strategy results and help researchers test ideas
Analyse tick and trade data in Python
Automate deployments and checks on trading servers
Work with FPGA engineers on hardware-accelerated paths
